## Checklist

- [ ] Public GitHub repo exists and is not archived
- [ ] It is a real MCP server that people can run or connect to (not a website-only / hosted endpoint without a public repo)
- [ ] Entry uses the exact format above (three spaces after `-`, bold linked `owner/repo`, stars badge for the **same** `owner/repo` with `style=social`, then `: ` and the description)
- [ ] Placed in the best existing category
- [ ] Not already listed in the README (I searched for my repo)
- [ ] Description is accurate and one concise sentence, ending with a period
- [ ] Diff is a single new bullet in `README.md` (no drive-by edits, no reformatting of unrelated lines)
